notes.title: Major Game Update
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone ![/h1]

After roughly 2 weeks, we have gathered feedback and pushed the first major update for Handyman taking in consideration user feedback.

[b]This update includes :[/b]

[b]•[/b]  Removing the time limit for minigames
[b]•[/b]  Adding more on-screen indications for imperfect repairs, forgotten elements, and more
[b]•[/b]  Double the time for the contracts to expire, which makes it that you can now peacefully and slowly complete your contracts, without worrying about time
[b]•[/b]  Reduced delivery times to 10s and 15s
[b]•[/b]  Fixed multiple bugs that will improve performances with contractors and the game in general
[b]•[/b]  Fixed freezing issues
[b]•[/b]  Fixed various minigames bugs, issues and unclarities

We hope that those will contribute to making the game closer to what future players want and will improve the experience of those currently playing the game.

[b]We thank you all for your efforts and feedback on the game issues and feelings and we wish you a happy new month ![/b]

notes.title: Handyman Hotfix Update
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are bringing you a hotfix based on the feedback that we received from you. We are very thankful for the positive and negative comments based on your first hand experience with the game. Both are quite valuable for us. We fixed the following issues: 

• Screwing mechanic sensitivity

• Performance issues due to large amounts of contracts

• Unable to fix TVs at certain points

• Unable to fix TV stands at certain points

• Wife getting bugged and merging with objects

• Other small bugs and improvements

We apologize for any inconvenience that the bugs may have caused.

Thank you for your patience and understanding.
